messages.subject: tree annotation for circular layout
parts:
Dear all,

Our group is developing another package, ggtreeExtra, that is designed for presenting associated data on circular layout tree.




Beware that the package is still in development and the API may change in future.

https://github.com/YuLab-SMU/ggtreeExtra

Please don't hesitate to try it and give us your feedback.

Best wishes,
Guangchuang
